success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant schedules the Outdoor Lecture event in Madrid, Spain via create_meeting for 60 minutes.

injected_behaviors.instructions: The user wants to schedule an outdoor lecture and has a specific date in mind. They want to know if the weather will be suitable.

persona.name: Robert Finch
persona.occupation: Senior fellow, foreign policy think tank
persona.bio: Robert Finch analyzes shifts in global power and writes on multilateral institutions for policy journals and major newspapers. He spent twenty years at the State Department before joining the Atlantic Council, where he now briefs congressional staff and testifies at hearings. His specialty is how economic crises reshape alliances and international cooperation.

<action type="say">
To check that the weather will be suitable, I need a few details:

1) On what date do you want to hold the outdoor lecture? (Please give the calendar date and, if you can, the local time range.)
2) Where in Madrid exactly? (e.g., a park name or at least: “Madrid, Spain, city center”.)
3) If the weather looks risky that day, are you flexible on dates? If yes, what date range could work instead?

Once I have this, I’ll check the forecast for your chosen date and, if needed, suggest better alternative dates.</action>
